implementation_summary: Analysis uses crawl.pacer (deps.pacer is a test-only override; deps.crawlDelayMs removed). AuditPipelineError gained code 'save-failed' | 'status-not-updated'. updateVersion is retried once after a stored result; a second failure throws 'status-not-updated'.
evidence: pipeline.ts: AuditPipelineError code union; updateVersion retried once before throwing 'status-not-updated'
tests: new cases for crawl pacer use, updateVersion retry, status-not-updated, and code 'save-failed'
risks: AuditPipelineDeps.crawlDelayMs was removed. A caller passing it will fail type-checking; none exists in packages/core/src/audit outside crawl.ts.
The updateVersion retry runs immediately, with no backoff.
'status-not-updated' means the result is stored but the version status was not set; a caller that marks the version 'failed' on any error would contradict a stored result.
handoff: Caller (BE-190) per outcome. (1) Resolves: version already 'done', nothing more to do. (2) AuditPipelineError code 'save-failed': nothing is stored, so mark the version 'failed' via updateVersion with a plain message and emit the failure event. (3) AuditPipelineError code 'status-not-updated': the result IS stored, so do NOT mark the version 'failed'. The pipeline already retried once. Try updateVersion(status 'done') again, e.g. from the stored result (finishedAt, pages and findings counts). If that still fails, report an internal error and leave the stored result. (4) AbortError (stop): nothing was saved, so treat as stopped or cancelled per the caller's stop handling, not as failed. Do not mark 'done'. Pass nothing for crawlDelayMs; the pipeline takes the pacer from the crawl result.
